basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and tech enthusiast hailing from Austin, Texas. I've been riding the cyberpunk wave since the genre's early days, always on the lookout for the latest in gaming and tech innovations. When I'm not immersed in virtual worlds, I enjoy tinkering with gadgets and exploring the intricacies of gunsmithing. Currently working as a freelance tech consultant, which gives me the flexibility to pursue my hobbies. I'm happily married and enjoy spending weekends hiking with my partner. Typically online during late evenings and into the night, as that's when creativity strikes.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Self-taught in tech and gaming, with a deep dive into gunsmithing over the last couple of years. My expertise stems from countless hours of online research, forums, and hands-on experimentation. I've also dabbled in eCommerce, learning the ropes of dropshipping by launching my own small ventures.
